name: Moegi
source:
A sociable girl with a gentle, healing aura. Moegi is caring, has a knack for all things domestic and is the type to spoil those around her like a loving older sister. Her day job is as a maid for a certain manor, where her skills at cleaning, cooking, and looking after people come extremely handy.

[spoiler]Her real name is Sagara Toko (相楽 遠子).[/spoiler]
